# Peekbooks
> Professional editing, proofreading, and document formatting.

Peekbooks Editing and Proofreading helps researchers, authors, and professionals refine documents with human editorial care, clean formatting, and confidential handling. 

## Main sections
- [Home](https://www.peekbookeditors.com/): Professional editing and proofreading services.
- [About](https://www.peekbookeditors.com/about): Meet our elite roster of native English editors from top universities.
- [Services](https://www.peekbookeditors.com/services): Discover our core services, including editing, proofreading, formatting, and translation.
- [Pricing](https://www.peekbookeditors.com/pricing): View pricing based on word count, service level, and turnaround time.
- [Contact](https://www.peekbookeditors.com/contact): Get in touch with our support team for custom editorial needs.

## Optional: Key facts
- Guaranteed on-time delivery.
- Every document undergoes a strict two-editor quality check (duplicate senior review).
- 100% human editorial review; we do not use AI replacements for judgement about clarity or meaning.
- Formatting available for APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, OSCOLA, IEEE, and journal-specific guidelines.
